reviewedSourceEvidence.howToFix: Replace the crankshaft position sensor with a genuine JLR or Bosch unit. Avoid cheap aftermarket sensors as they fail quickly. The sensor is located on the lower front of the engine block and is relatively accessible. Also inspect and clean the wiring connector for corrosion.
